name: Al Bhed Treasures

start.dialog: Hey hey! Heard there's old Al Bhed tech hidden in these mountains! My people were here way back! Help me find it? I'll make it worth your while!
start.objective: Search the Uplands mountains for hidden Al Bhed technology

progress.dialog: The tech should be in a hidden cache! Look for the lightning-bolt symbol! That's us!
progress.objective: Continue searching for Al Bhed symbols and caches

complete.dialog: You found it! Look at this tech! Ancient but still functional! Here, take this - a fully upgraded Al Bhed potion. Mix of healing and buffs! Best of both worlds!

party_comments.kade: She's got a lot of energy. And knows her machines.
party_comments.nix7: Al Bhed technology. Compatible with my systems. Interesting.
party_comments.twist: Can I press the buttons?! Please?!

hidden_outcome: If you find all three hidden caches, Rikku gives you 'Godhand' - a legendary claw weapon
